scenarios.title: Synthetic link-based social-engineering simulation
scenarios.objective: Validate that the training workflow generates correlated synthetic delivery, click and detection evidence.
scope: Only the five synthetic identities shipped with the lab
Delivery only to the local MailHog sink
permitted_actions: Send the preconfigured message to synthetic identities
Open training links from the local MailHog interface
Review resulting synthetic events and detections
prohibited_actions: Real identities, recipients or personal data
External delivery, domains, targets or infrastructure
Unbounded payloads, arbitrary templates or exploit execution
stop_conditions: Any real identity or credential is introduced
Traffic leaves the isolated lab network
Mail is not confined to the local MailHog sink
success_evidence: A correlated campaign run in synthetic telemetry
HHL-D001 or HHL-D002 evidence after controlled training interactions
